raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- GPT-OSS-20B BF16/FP8: align with the tuned MI300X configs (#1329): Primus-Turbo grouped GEMM (hipBLASLt backend), Turbo RMSNorm and norm+TE linear, DeepEP, sync-free MoE stage 2, gradient accumulation fusion, fp32 router, micro batch size 8 -> 4.
- ZAYA1-8B BF16: micro batch size 216 -> 184 and global batch size 1728 -> 1472 (one micro batch per GPU per step at DP=8) to prevent OOM

nodes.body:
<!-- pr-pundit-live:primus-1354-d0701c3a -->
### PR Pundit review
10 findings, 4 as comments on the diff below.

| # | | Finding | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🟠 | MI325X GPT-OSS-20B examples train without learned attention sinks: this PR dropped `use_sink_attention` | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:82` ↓ |
| 2 | 🟠 | MI325X GPT-OSS FP8 re-enables delayed-scaling patches that caused a memory fault: this PR dropped `disable_delayed_scaling_patches` | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-FP8-pretrain.yaml:108` ↓ |
| 3 | 🟠 | MI325X GPT-OSS outputs go to `<login>` dir and ignore `PRIMUS_*` overrides: this PR renamed header env vars | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:1-3` ↓ |
| 4 | 🟠 | MI325X GPT-OSS configs carry MI300X tuning rationale: this PR copied MI300X files verbatim | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:84` ↓ |
| 5 | 🟠 | ZAYA1-8B BF16 comment still documents micro batch 216 after this PR lowered it to 184 | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/zaya1_8B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:23-29` |
| 6 | 🟠 | `gradient_accumulation_fusion` enabled in MI325X GPT-OSS configs despite NaN reports elsewhere | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:53` |
| 7 | 🔵 | GPT-OSS-20B W&B runs land in DeepSeek project: this PR copied MI300X `wandb_project` | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:15` |
| 8 | 🔵 | Comment calls fused-act-with-probs a stage-3 feature while config uses stage 2 | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:100-101` |
| 9 | 🔵 | MI325X GPT-OSS may miss fused QK RMSNorm+RoPE speedup used by MI355X/MI455X | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:81` |
| 10 | 🔵 | MI325X GPT-OSS FP8 config does not use the Turbo FP8 paths of the MI355X sibling | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-FP8-pretrain.yaml:108` |

#### 5. 🟠 Should fix: ZAYA1-8B BF16 comment still documents micro batch 216 after this PR lowered it to 184
`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/zaya1_8B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:23-29`

This PR lowers `micro_batch_size` from 216 to 184 (`global_batch_size` 1728 to 1472). The comment above it, from #1269, still says 216 is the largest multiple of 8 that fits, peaking at 249 of 256 GB, and that 224 runs out of memory. The comment now contradicts the value. The FP8 sibling's comment already documented 184 before this PR. Update the comment, or say why BF16 now uses the FP8 batch size.

**Who is affected:** Readers of the MI325X ZAYA1-8B BF16 example config who rely on its memory notes.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

<details><summary>Nits and less certain findings (5)</summary>

**6. `gradient_accumulation_fusion` enabled in MI325X GPT-OSS configs despite NaN reports elsewhere** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:53`)

`gradient_accumulation_fusion` is flipped from false to true in both configs with no rationale, while `overlap_grad_reduce`/`overlap_param_gather` stay on. The MI325X deepseek_v2_lite recipe notes that true caused intermittent grad-norm NaNs, and the MI300X/MI355X GPT-OSS siblings keep it false. Revert it, or justify the change with MI325X validation.

_An independent check of the code found this probably does not apply: `diff` of MI300X vs MI325X `gpt_oss_20B-{BF16,FP8}-pretrain.yaml` in head/ is empty, MI300X sets `gradient_accumulation_fusion: true`, and `language_model.yaml:180` defaults it to true; the cited 'H0.4' review is not in the repo. The NaN note is specific to the `deepseek_v2_lite` recipe, so the claim that the GPT-OSS siblings keep it false is wrong._

**Related past reviews:** [#145](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/145) on `examples/megatron/configs/deepseek_v2-pretrain.yaml`

**7. GPT-OSS-20B W&B runs land in DeepSeek project: this PR copied MI300X `wandb_project`** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:15`)

Both MI325X GPT-OSS configs now set `wandb_project: "Primus_DeepSeek_Pretrain"`, copied from the MI300X GPT-OSS template, which already carries the same leftover name. With W&B enabled, GPT-OSS-20B runs are filed under the DeepSeek project. By default `disable_wandb: true`, and the wandb patch then clears `wandb_project`, so default runs are unaffected. Restore `Primus_GPT_OSS_20B_Pretrain`. The new comments also cite MI300X ('160 for ep8 on MI300X', 'OOMs on MI300X') in MI325X files.

**Who is affected:** Users who set `disable_wandb: false` and run the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B BF16/FP8 example configs.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**8. Comment calls fused-act-with-probs a stage-3 feature while config uses stage 2** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:100-101`)

`use_turbo_fused_act_with_probs: true` is commented as 'stage 3's fused activation' but is set alongside `turbo_sync_free_moe_stage: 2`. experts.py applies it regardless of stage, so it does change the stage-2 activation path. Reword the comment to say it is deliberately enabled on top of stage 2, and note the swiglu/gelu and no-`glu_linear_offset` requirement.

_An independent check of the code found this probably does not apply: `bias_act_func_with_mask` in experts.py checks only `use_turbo_fused_act_with_probs`, so the flag works at stage 2; the comment 'stage 3's fused activation; stage 3 itself OOMs on MI300X' accurately says the stage-3 feature is enabled on its own because full stage 3 OOMs. The base MI300X gpt_oss_20B config already uses the same comment and flag pair; GPT-OSS uses swiglu with no `glu_linear_offset` or `activation_func_fp8_input_store` set, so the asserts cannot fire, and the 'not validated' remar…_

**Related past reviews:** [#220](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/220) on `tests/trainer/test_megatron_trainer.py`

**9. MI325X GPT-OSS may miss fused QK RMSNorm+RoPE speedup used by MI355X/MI455X** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:81`)

Optional, not a defect: `use_turbo_fused_qk_rmsnorm_rope` (default `false` in `primus_turbo.yaml`) stays unset in the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B BF16/FP8 configs, while the MI355X and MI455X siblings enable it. GPT-OSS-20B looks eligible for the patch's `_eligible` check: `qk_layernorm: true` via `deepseek_v2_base.yaml`, `kv_channels: 64`, TP=1. Before enabling it on MI325X, confirm the FlyDSL kernel runs on gfx942. `examples/megatron/models/deepseek-v4/gfx942/README.md` reports that other Primus-Turbo FlyDSL kernels emit gfx950-only instructions there.

**Origin:** pre-existing

**Who is affected:** Users running the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B example configs who want the most performance; behaviour and correctness are unchanged.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**10. MI325X GPT-OSS FP8 config does not use the Turbo FP8 paths of the MI355X sibling** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-FP8-pretrain.yaml:108`)

The FP8 recipe uses only TE `fp8: hybrid` and none of the MI355X sibling's Turbo FP8 paths (`turbo_fused_grouped_gemm`, `turbo_fp8_permute` with tensorwise, `use_turbo_gemm` fp8 backend). The MI300X config lacks them too, so this is a follow-up suggestion rather than a regression.

_An independent check of the code found this probably does not apply: After the PR, the MI325X FP8 config matches the MI300X gfx942 sibling (same Turbo flags plus `fp8: hybrid`), so the candidate is a feature suggestion, not a defect in this PR. Part of the suggested MI355X setup does not port to MI325X: its `turbo_gemm_backend` uses `flydsl`, which the Primus sources describe as gfx950/CDNA4-only, and MI325X is gfx942._

</details>

**1. 🟠 Should fix: MI325X GPT-OSS-20B examples train without learned attention sinks: this PR dropped `use_sink_attention`**

Both MI325X GPT-OSS-20B configs (BF16 and FP8) drop `use_sink_attention: true`, so the default `use_sink_attention: false` from `primus_turbo.yaml:41` applies. With it, `PrimusTurboAttention` creates no learned `sinks` and runs plain attention. The MI325X sliding window was already `0`, so only the learned sinks are lost. The PR copies the MI300X block, which also has no sink settings; MI325X now matches MI300X but differs from its own previous config (#616, #783) and from the MI355X/MI455X siblings. Re-add `use_sink_attention: true`, or state in the config that the change is intentional.

**Who is affected:** Users running the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B BF16/FP8 example pretrain configs.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

nodes.body:
**2. 🟠 Should fix: MI325X GPT-OSS FP8 re-enables delayed-scaling patches that caused a memory fault: this PR dropped `disable_delayed_scaling_patches`**

The PR replaces this file with the MI300X version and drops `fp8_recipe: delayed` and `disable_delayed_scaling_patches: true`. #900 (27a162d) added that guard because the `delayed_fp8_scaling` stream patches crashed this MI325X config with a GPU memory fault (`sum_and_scatter`) at about iter 6. With `fp8: hybrid`, `fp8_recipe` still inherits `delayed` from `trainer_base.yaml`, and `disable_delayed_scaling_patches` falls back to False. `_needs_delayed_scaling` is therefore True, so `megatron.fp8.delayed_scaling_update` and `megatron.grad_zero_and_data_prefetch` are installed again. The other MI325X FP8 configs still keep the flag; either keep it here, switch to `fp8_recipe: tensorwise`, or document why the new Turbo/DeepEP setup no longer faults.

**Who is affected:** Users running the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B FP8 pretrain example as shipped.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

nodes.body:
**3. 🟠 Should fix: MI325X GPT-OSS outputs go to `<login>` dir and ignore `PRIMUS_*` overrides: this PR renamed header env vars**

Both MI325X GPT-OSS configs (BF16 and FP8) switch the header from `${PRIMUS_TEAM}`/`${PRIMUS_USER}`/`${PRIMUS_EXP_NAME}` to `${TEAM}`/`${USER}`/`${EXP_NAME}`, copying the MI300X `gpt_oss_20B` configs. The other 68 MI325X configs and the docs (`environment-variables.md`, `run_odc.sh`) use the `PRIMUS_*` names, so setting `PRIMUS_EXP_NAME`/`PRIMUS_USER`/`PRIMUS_TEAM` no longer has any effect on these two configs. Because `USER` is set by the shell, `${USER:root}` resolves to the login name, so the experiment directory moves to `./output/amd/<login>/gpt_oss_20b`. Training itself is unaffected; restore the `PRIMUS_*` names for consistency.

**Who is affected:** Users running the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B examples who set `PRIMUS_EXP_NAME`/`PRIMUS_USER`/`PRIMUS_TEAM` (e.g. via `run_odc.sh`) or expect the documented output path.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**Related past reviews:** [#440](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/440) on `examples/run_pretrain.sh`

**4. 🟠 Should fix: MI325X GPT-OSS configs carry MI300X tuning rationale: this PR copied MI300X files verbatim**

The MI325X `gpt_oss_20B-BF16/FP8-pretrain.yaml` files are now byte-identical copies of the MI300X configs. Their comments still describe MI300X (`the default Triton grouped GEMM is slower on MI300X`, `160 for ep8 on MI300X`, `stage 3 itself OOMs on MI300X`). Fix the comments to refer to MI325X, or state that the MI300X settings were measured on MI325X. The removed `moe_permute_fusion` / `moe_use_fused_router_with_aux_score` settings are re-enabled by `turbo_sync_free_moe_stage: 2`, so that part is not a behaviour loss.

**Who is affected:** Readers and tuners of the MI325X GPT-OSS 20B example configs.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**3. 🟠 Should fix: MI325X GPT-OSS outputs go to `<login>` dir and ignore `PRIMUS_*` overrides: this PR renamed header env vars**

Both MI325X GPT-OSS configs (BF16 and FP8) switch the header from `${PRIMUS_TEAM}`/`${PRIMUS_USER}`/`${PRIMUS_EXP_NAME}` to `${TEAM}`/`${USER}`/`${EXP_NAME}`, copying the MI300X `gpt_oss_20B` configs. Training itself is unaffected; restore the `PRIMUS_*` names for consistency.

### PR Pundit review
10 findings, 4 as comments on the diff below.

| # | | Finding | Where |

| 1 | 🟠 | MI325X GPT-OSS-20B examples train without learned attention sinks: this PR dropped `use_sink_attention` | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:82` ↓ |

| 5 | 🟠 | ZAYA1-8B BF16 comment still documents micro batch 216 after this PR lowered it to 184 | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/zaya1_8B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:23-29` |
| 6 | 🟠 | `gradient_accumulation_fusion` enabled in MI325X GPT-OSS configs despite NaN reports elsewhere | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:53` |
| 7 | 🔵 | GPT-OSS-20B W&B runs land in DeepSeek project: this PR copied MI300X `wandb_project` | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:15` |
| 8 | 🔵 | Comment calls fused-act-with-probs a stage-3 feature while config uses stage 2 | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:100-101` |
| 9 | 🔵 | MI325X GPT-OSS may miss fused QK RMSNorm+RoPE speedup used by MI355X/MI455X | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:81` |
| 10 | 🔵 | MI325X GPT-OSS FP8 config does not use the Turbo FP8 paths of the MI355X sibling | `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-FP8-pretrain.yaml:108` |

#### 5. 🟠 Should fix: ZAYA1-8B BF16 comment still documents micro batch 216 after this PR lowered it to 184
`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/zaya1_8B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:23-29`

This PR lowers `micro_batch_size` from 216 to 184 (`global_batch_size` 1728 to 1472). The comment above it, from #1269, still says 216 is the largest multiple of 8 that fits, peaking at 249 of 256 GB, and that 224 runs out of memory. The comment now contradicts the value. The FP8 sibling's comment already documented 184 before this PR. Update the comment, or say why BF16 now uses the FP8 batch size.

**Who is affected:** Readers of the MI325X ZAYA1-8B BF16 example config who rely on its memory notes.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

<details><summary>Nits and less certain findings (5)</summary>

**6. `gradient_accumulation_fusion` enabled in MI325X GPT-OSS configs despite NaN reports elsewhere** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:53`)

`gradient_accumulation_fusion` is flipped from false to true in both configs with no rationale, while `overlap_grad_reduce`/`overlap_param_gather` stay on. The MI325X deepseek_v2_lite recipe notes that true caused intermittent grad-norm NaNs, and the MI300X/MI355X GPT-OSS siblings keep it false. Revert it, or justify the change with MI325X validation.

_An independent check of the code found this probably does not apply: `diff` of MI300X vs MI325X `gpt_oss_20B-{BF16,FP8}-pretrain.yaml` in head/ is empty, MI300X sets `gradient_accumulation_fusion: true`, and `language_model.yaml:180` defaults it to true; the cited 'H0.4' review is not in the repo. The NaN note is specific to the `deepseek_v2_lite` recipe, so the claim that the GPT-OSS siblings keep it false is wrong._

**Related past reviews:** [#145](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/145) on `examples/megatron/configs/deepseek_v2-pretrain.yaml`

**7. GPT-OSS-20B W&B runs land in DeepSeek project: this PR copied MI300X `wandb_project`** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:15`)

Both MI325X GPT-OSS configs now set `wandb_project: "Primus_DeepSeek_Pretrain"`, copied from the MI300X GPT-OSS template, which already carries the same leftover name. With W&B enabled, GPT-OSS-20B runs are filed under the DeepSeek project. By default `disable_wandb: true`, and the wandb patch then clears `wandb_project`, so default runs are unaffected. Restore `Primus_GPT_OSS_20B_Pretrain`. The new comments also cite MI300X ('160 for ep8 on MI300X', 'OOMs on MI300X') in MI325X files.

**Who is affected:** Users who set `disable_wandb: false` and run the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B BF16/FP8 example configs.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**8. Comment calls fused-act-with-probs a stage-3 feature while config uses stage 2** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:100-101`)

`use_turbo_fused_act_with_probs: true` is commented as 'stage 3's fused activation' but is set alongside `turbo_sync_free_moe_stage: 2`. experts.py applies it regardless of stage, so it does change the stage-2 activation path. Reword the comment to say it is deliberately enabled on top of stage 2, and note the swiglu/gelu and no-`glu_linear_offset` requirement.

_An independent check of the code found this probably does not apply: `bias_act_func_with_mask` in experts.py checks only `use_turbo_fused_act_with_probs`, so the flag works at stage 2; the comment 'stage 3's fused activation; stage 3 itself OOMs on MI300X' accurately says the stage-3 feature is enabled on its own because full stage 3 OOMs. The base MI300X gpt_oss_20B config already uses the same comment and flag pair; GPT-OSS uses swiglu with no `glu_linear_offset` or `activation_func_fp8_input_store` set, so the asserts cannot fire, and the 'not validated' remar…_

**Related past reviews:** [#220](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/220) on `tests/trainer/test_megatron_trainer.py`

**9. MI325X GPT-OSS may miss fused QK RMSNorm+RoPE speedup used by MI355X/MI455X** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:81`)

Optional, not a defect: `use_turbo_fused_qk_rmsnorm_rope` (default `false` in `primus_turbo.yaml`) stays unset in the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B BF16/FP8 configs, while the MI355X and MI455X siblings enable it. GPT-OSS-20B looks eligible for the patch's `_eligible` check: `qk_layernorm: true` via `deepseek_v2_base.yaml`, `kv_channels: 64`, TP=1. Before enabling it on MI325X, confirm the FlyDSL kernel runs on gfx942. `examples/megatron/models/deepseek-v4/gfx942/README.md` reports that other Primus-Turbo FlyDSL kernels emit gfx950-only instructions there.

**Origin:** pre-existing

**Who is affected:** Users running the MI325X GPT-OSS-20B example configs who want the most performance; behaviour and correctness are unchanged.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**10. MI325X GPT-OSS FP8 config does not use the Turbo FP8 paths of the MI355X sibling** (`examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/gpt_oss_20B-FP8-pretrain.yaml:108`)

The FP8 recipe uses only TE `fp8: hybrid` and none of the MI355X sibling's Turbo FP8 paths (`turbo_fused_grouped_gemm`, `turbo_fp8_permute` with tensorwise, `use_turbo_gemm` fp8 backend). The MI300X config lacks them too, so this is a follow-up suggestion rather than a regression.

_An independent check of the code found this probably does not apply: After the PR, the MI325X FP8 config matches the MI300X gfx942 sibling (same Turbo flags plus `fp8: hybrid`), so the candidate is a feature suggestion, not a defect in this PR. Part of the suggested MI355X setup does not port to MI325X: its `turbo_gemm_backend` uses `flydsl`, which the Primus sources describe as gfx950/CDNA4-only, and MI325X is gfx942._

</details>
